item.title: Show HN: Benchmark local LLMs fit for your device specs
item.summary: Benchmark local LLMs with custom sets of tasks via Ollama and similar providers on a wide variety of metrics. You can use deterministic evaluation criteria or LLM judges with custom instructions. This also supports querying HuggingFace to compare trending models with your device's specs so you know which models might be worth testing in your setup.
